better-sg-reports.js.description: This script creates an interactive dashboard for analyzing site and server performance metrics on SiteGround, including CPU, memory, and request data. It helps users identify issues, validate fixes, and generate branded PDF or CSV reports directly from the browser.
usage: Open the dashboard page on SiteGround with the monitoring data available.
Run the bookmarklet or userscript on the page to initialize the dashboard view.
Use the provided UI controls to switch tabs, toggle explain mode, exclude sites, compare before/after periods, and generate reports.
Ensure your browser allows pop-ups, and wait for the page to load the data before interacting.

ie-extractor.js.description: This script creates a floating image extractor panel on any page, which collects all images, detects if they are from iStock, and displays them in a sortable table. You can filter images by filename, alt text, or iStock ID, select images, and download their files directly. It enhances image management without altering page content permanently.
usage: Run the bookmarklet while on a page with images to activate the extractor panel.
Click the 🖼 Images FAB button to show/hide the panel.
Use the search box or filters to find specific images by filename, alt, or iStock ID.
Click download options in the panel to save selected images.
